meta.note: Source: 'QUARTERLY DISCLOSURE OF THE PORTFOLIO, NCCBL MUTUAL FUND-1, REPORT FOR THE MONTH: JUNE 30, 2018' (LR Global Bangladesh AMC). Main portfolio table lists only Average acquisition cost / Market price PER SHARE OR UNIT plus total Acquisition cost / Market price -- no absolute share/unit-count column is printed anywhere in the source -- so 'shares' is set to 0 for every holding (not available in source; dividing total cost by the printed per-share average does not resolve to clean integers since the per-share figure is itself rounded to 2 decimals), consistent with prior NCCBLMF1 quarters using this identical LR Global report format. The main table's 21 rows (labelled Bank/Cement/Food & Allied/Mutual Funds/Pharmaceuticals/Tannery/Telecom/Textile) sum to the printed Total of Tk. 812,601,748 (cost) / Tk. 938,163,735 (market), but the PDF's own 'Total investment' summary box reclassifies 5 of the 7 'Mutual Funds' rows -- CAPM Unit Fund (Tk. 3,000,000/3,446,100), IDLC Balanced Fund (6,000,000/6,192,000), Penninsula AMCL BDBL Unit Fund One (1,000,000/1,135,000), Peninsula Sadharan Bima Corporation Unit Fund One (1,030,000/919,790), and VIPB Accelerated Income Unit Fund (11,630,000/12,830,000) -- as 'Non-listed Mutual Fund', separate from 'Secondary Market Investment'/'Mutual Funds (listed)'. Only LR Global Bangladesh Mutual Fund One and Southeast Bank 1st Mutual Fund are confirmed DSE-listed (their combined market value of Tk. 122,569,345 in the 'Mutual Funds (listed)' summary row reflects an 85%-of-NAV loss-recovery adjustment to LR Global's market value per the report's separate 'Recovery of unrealized loss' table -- Tk. 102,528,399 + 8,275,701 recovery = 110,804,100 -- but this JSON uses the unadjusted per-row market price of Tk. 102,528,399 printed in the main table for consistency with all other rows). Excludes the above 5 non-listed MF units, plus IPO Investment (SK Trims & Industries Ltd., VFS Thread Dyeing Ltd.), Corporate Bond (BSRM Zero Coupon Bond, Trust Bank Ltd. Subordinated Bond, United Commercial Bank Ltd. Bond), preference share (Thyrocare Bangladesh Ltd.), and Cash & Cash Equivalents (Cash at bank, FDR) shown in the same summary box, as none are listed equity or listed MF/CIS unit holdings. Sum of extracted 16 holdings (14 equity + 2 listed MF) = Cost Tk. 789,941,748 / Market Tk. 913,640,847, versus main-table printed Total of Tk. 812,601,748 / Tk. 938,163,735 less the 5 excluded non-listed MF rows (Tk. 22,660,000 cost / Tk. 24,522,890 market) = expected Tk. 789,941,748 / Tk. 913,640,845 -- a Tk. 2 rounding difference on the market side, within the PDF's own rounding.
